watch.summary: The creator watches videos of parkour robots, imagining a chaotic future Robot Olympics filled with cyberattacks before concluding that humanity is doomed.

beats.what: Creator says he would pay good money to watch a Robot Olympics where robots crash and glitch out.
He speculates that teams would start hacking each other's robots with DDoS attacks during competitions.
Watching the robot jump seamlessly over obstacles, he holds his head and admits humans are cooked.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Guys, we're in trouble man, we're cooked.
watch.why: The creator constructs a funny hypothetical about robot sports turning into cyberwarfare. His humorous scenario contrasts nicely with his final realization of how advanced the tech actually is.
